title: Upkeep of Oxygen Production and Storage Systems
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC PHILADELPHIA DIV
detail_text: The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division intends to procure Upkeep of Oxygen Production and Storage Systems services on a sole souce basis from PCI. The proposed contract action is for supplies or services for which the Government intends to solicit and award with only one source under authority of FAR 13.106(b). Any questions regarding this notice should be emailed to: zachary.f.mccurry.civ@us.navy.mil Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
